catalysts.headline: Four presentations at the Heart Failure Society of America (HFSA) Annual Scientific Meeting, Phoenix (Oct 9-12), incl. two Late-Breaking Clinical Research presentations on aficamten in non-obstructive HCM and right-ventricular function/dosing-safety data

Full ACACIA-HCM Phase 3 data (non-obstructive HCM) presented in a Hot Line session at ESC Congress 2026 (Munich) and published in NEJM; met both dual primary endpoints (KCCQ-CSS and peak VO2 vs placebo at Week 36); some reporting flagged a heart-failure imbalance early in dosing (10 vs 3 cases), which the company attributed to early dosing practices since adjusted
Late-stage data showed the drug significantly improved symptoms in patients with a genetic heart condition

Cytokinetics reported Q2 2026 results: MYQORZO (aficamten) net product revenue $25.3M, above ~$17.7M consensus; GAAP net loss widened to $198.8M ($1.50/share) from $134.4M ($1.12/share) YoY on higher launch-related SG&A; raised FY2026 combined R&D+SG&A guidance to $860M–$890M; ended the quarter with $1.7B cash after a $760M public offering; plans an sNDA filing for aficamten in non-obstructive HCM in Q4 2026 following positive Phase 3 ACACIA-HCM data
catalysts.impact: Product launch beat masked by higher net loss from commercial investment; balance sheet strengthened via large equity raise
